title: flow ac update: amend a criterion's text, and refuse arguments it does not use

AC1.note: service.test.ts:159 'AC1: acUpdate with --criterion/--text rewrites an existing criterion's line, re-freezes, and records old+new text in history' and :206 '...appends when ACn is the next unused number' prove replace+append+history(criterion,previous,new,reason). AC1's contract covers criteria in the documented single-line '- ACn:' format (Rules section); such criteria ARE replaced. T10's refusal (store.ts, write-ac-criterion.test.ts 'a criterion wrapped across two lines is refused, and the file is byte-identical') only fires when the target already has continuation lines in the file -- an input shape AC1 never promises to handle -- so it is a safety refusal outside AC1's scope, consistent with AC1 as written, not a violation.

AC2.note: service.test.ts:248 'AC2: acUpdate with --reason alone still re-freezes the file as edited, unchanged from before flow 293' writes the file directly, calls acUpdate with only --reason, and asserts the operator-edited text is re-frozen and the history detail is exactly the reason string -- matching pre-293 behaviour byte for byte.

AC3.note: ac-strict-args.test.ts:89 'AC3: ac update <id> AC1 --text ... --reason ... (the pre-293 syntax) is refused, and nothing changes' runs the exact invocation that was silently accepted before flow 293 and asserts refusal plus byte-identical file/checksum. Plus :107 refuses --text without --criterion, :119 refuses --criterion without --text, :131 refuses an unknown flag, :155/:166 ac confirm refuses extra positional/unknown flag, :177/:189 ac reseal refuses extra positional/unknown flag -- covering every flow ac subcommand.

AC4.note: service.test.ts:271 'AC4: acUpdate validates --criterion and --text before writing anything' asserts rejection for empty text, multi-line text, text carrying its own '- AC1:' prefix, a criterion name not matching AC\d+, and undefined text -- each rejection message names the broken rule (see :294 assertion on the criterion-name error message).

AC5.note: docs/docs/cli-reference.md:2074-2077 documents both 'ac update <id> --reason' and '--criterion ACn --text "<criterion>" together with --reason' rows, and states every ac subcommand refuses an argument it does not use. src/commands/flow.ts:1064,1066 CLI help text states the same: the --criterion/--text usage line and 'every flow ac subcommand refuses an argument it does not use...'. Verified via bun run src/cli.ts flow ac --help and direct read of both files.
